datasets.name: HITL Car Parts and Car Damages
datasets.access: Complete the publisher access form, then configure all supplied part and damage archives in local sources.

datasets.name: DSMLR Car-Parts-Segmentation
datasets.license: No explicit dataset licence found in the inspected README; verify with owner.
datasets.access: Record original permission evidence in local sources; pinned repository archive contains the dataset.

datasets.name: VehiDE
datasets.license: Mirror advertises Apache-2.0; original release terms remain unverified.
datasets.access: Verify original terms and record permission evidence; install/authenticate the official Kaggle CLI. Optionally configure local archives.

datasets.name: CarDD
datasets.license: Publisher licensing form and granted access required.
datasets.access: Obtain access through the publisher licensing process, then configure supplied archives or authorized direct URLs.

datasets.name: CrashCar101
datasets.license: Publisher gate requires non-commercial use and access approval.
datasets.access: Request access on Hugging Face and set HF_TOKEN for an approved account; install huggingface_hub.

datasets.name: DocILE annotated train/validation and test
datasets.license: Obtain publisher access token and follow accompanying dataset terms; repository code is MIT.
datasets.access: Obtain publisher token and set DOCILE_TOKEN. Default downloads annotated-trainval and test; --docile-extras adds synthetic and all unlabeled chunks.

datasets.name: CORD v2
datasets.license: CC-BY-4.0 (publisher README and Hugging Face card; differs from proposal)
datasets.access: Install huggingface_hub; public publisher-linked v2 snapshot includes all splits as Parquet.

datasets.name: SROIE
datasets.license: Verify dataset terms at the official competition portal; proposal MIT claim not independently established.
datasets.access: Register/sign in at the official portal and configure downloaded training/test images and annotations; portal unavailable during source check.

datasets.name: FUNSD
datasets.license: Publisher asks users to read licence before download; proposal records non-commercial academic use. Confirm original terms.
datasets.access: Record licence/access evidence in local sources before downloading the publisher ZIP.

datasets.name: Ultralytics Carparts-Seg
datasets.license: Publisher YAML is marked AGPL-3.0; review dataset/original-source terms for intended use.
datasets.access: Reserve source: select explicitly or use --include-reserve; record licence review evidence.

datasets.name: Project synthetic prices_dataset.csv
datasets.license: Project-owned synthetic input; no public source supplied.
datasets.access: Supply the actual synthetic CSV in local sources. This script does not invent the proposed 630 rows or infer operation/damage/currency fields.

datasets.name: Project synthetic survey reports
datasets.license: Project-owned synthetic layouts; no public source supplied.
datasets.access: Supply a synthetic survey-report archive. Generation, template grouping and label conversion are separate work.

datasets.name: Real vehicle-grouped evaluation photos
datasets.license: No suitable public source identified; authorized and anonymised project collection required.
datasets.access: Supply an authorized archive and permission evidence, preserving vehicle grouping. CrashCar101 is only the synthetic comparator.
